title: Protection Against Nazar (Evil Eye) & Negative Energy

spiritualGoal: Protection against envy and negative energy

englishDescription: It is strongly recommended to recite Surah Al-Falaq and Surah An-Nas 3 times each morning and evening, then blow over oneself and one's children. This provides spiritual protection against envy, jealousy, malicious gazes, and sorcery.

englishDescription: It is obligatory to always perform the five daily prayers in congregation (Jama’at). If one cannot attend the mosque for valid Islamic legal (Shar’i) reasons, arrange Jama’at at home with the family.

englishDescription: Maintain a state of purity (Wudu) at all times. Sleeping in Wudu protects against demonic forces. If you wake up during the night, renew your Wudu before making Du’a. This guarantees that your prayer is answered or replaced with something better.

title: Khar-i-Anfas (Pas-i-Anfas): Breathing Technique with Kalima Tayyiba
urdu: سانس کے ساتھ ذکر کو جوڑیں: لا الہ الا اللہ (انہیل) محمد الرسول اللہ (ایکزیل)۔

englishDescription: Connect Dhikr directly to your breath: Recite "La ilaha illallah" upon inhaling, and "Muhammadur Rasulullah" upon exhaling. This automatically dispels dark forces, magic, and demons while kindling spiritual fire in the heart.

title: Nazar (Evil Eye) Symptoms in Children & Exorcism Precautions
urdu: نظربد سے بچہ روتا ہے، بیمار اور ڈپریشن میں جاتا ہے۔ اگر کوئی اور دم کر رہا ہو تو خود ہاتھ نہ لگائیں۔
spiritualGoal: Protecting children from envy and ensuring safe spiritual treatment
body: نظربد سے بچہ روتا ہے، بیمار اور ڈپریشن میں جاتا ہے۔ اگر کوئی اور دم کر رہا ہو تو خود ہاتھ نہ لگائیں۔
englishDescription: Severe evil eye (Nazar) causes infants and young children to cry relentlessly, fall sick, and sink into dark depression. When performing Dam, exercise extreme caution: never perform Dam or touch the head if another spiritual healer is actively working on the patient.

spiritualGoal: Purifying the heart to naturally dispel diseases
body: دل کو محبت سے بھریں اور غصہ نکالیں کیونکہ غصہ شیطان کی طرف سے ہے، دل پاک ہو تو بیماریاں بھاگ جاتی ہیں۔
